label: AWS infrastructure files
about: What to look for in Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation/SAM and Serverless Framework changes: IAM, exposure, replacement, cost. Files only.
tested: Run end to end on one Terraform fixture (S3 bucket, IAM policy, security group, RDS) with a real model: all 7 planted risks found in 2 of 2 runs, no false alarm (a tag-only change was rated low). NOT run against a model: CDK, CloudFormation/SAM, Serverless Framework (their file detection is unit-tested only), modules spread over many files, large diffs, real repositories. Files only, so live drift is not visible. The note has not been reviewed by an AWS specialist.
